name: Half-Elf
age: Half-elves mature at the same rate humans do and reach adulthood around the age of 20. They live much longer than humans, however, often exceeding 180 years.
alignment: Half-elves share the chaotic bent of their elven heritage. They value both personal freedom and creative expression, demonstrating neither love of leaders nor desire for followers. They chafe at rules, resent others' demands, and sometimes prove unreliable, or at least unpredictable.
languages: You can speak, read, and write Common, Elvish, and one extra language of your choice.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.desc: Your Charisma score increases by 2 (already in the bonus summary), and two other ability scores of your choice each increase by 1. Pick two abilities other than Charisma and apply +1 to each on your character sheet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.desc: Thanks to your elf blood, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Skill Versatility
traits.desc: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice. (Pick two and add them to your skills list at character creation.)

traits.name: Extra Language
traits.desc: You can speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice. (Write it into your languages list.)
